lines: Nobody tells you this when you start a practice. You become the bottleneck.
I did the free Business Health Check on the GBX Professional Services site. Two minutes. It said my problem was process, not sales.
So we did the ten-day Performance Diagnostic. Fixed fee. They talked to my team, not just me. I got a written report and a ninety-day plan that I own.
Three months on, work leaves this office without going through me. Start with the free check. Link's in my bio.
I thought I needed more leads. Turns out I needed a pipeline I could actually read.
The GBX Professional Services team started with our numbers, our process and our pipeline. In that order. No slide deck.
The only AI they put in was the boring stuff. Quote follow-ups. Job sheets. Nothing my guys had to learn.
Practical, and only where it helped. That's the whole review. G B X P S dot com.
Every consultant I have met wanted to sell me something at the end.
GBX Professional Services has no licence and no products. So the advice isn't tied to anything. That's why I picked them.
They also ran a money session for my team. Plain language, at work, no pitch. My staff still talk about it.
A clearer picture, not more advice. Free tools first, then the Diagnostic if you want it.
